readerCopy.body: Something familiar can provide exactly enough support to make an unfamiliar direction easier to try. When the Moon sextiles the North Node, care and forward movement cooperate, allowing a routine, home base, practical favor, or close relationship to reduce the cost of change. The support does not have to recreate the old life. Its value is that it frees enough time, sleep, money, or emotional capacity for the new arrangement to have a fair test.
